results.title: Search engine visibility matches the environment
results.summary: Search engines are allowed to index this production site.

results.title: Site URLs are public and consistent
results.summary: Site URL problems: WordPress Address uses a local or staging host (127.0.0.1); Site Address uses a local or staging host (127.0.0.1).
results.recommendation: Update the URLs in Settings > General (or in wp-config.php) to the final public address, then check that no staging URLs remain in content.

results.title: robots.txt does not block the whole site
results.summary: There is no physical robots.txt; WordPress serves its own, controlled by the search visibility setting.

results.title: Pretty permalinks are enabled
results.summary: The site uses plain permalinks such as ?p=123.
results.recommendation: Choose a descriptive structure (for example "Post name") in Settings > Permalinks. Set up redirects first if the site already has indexed URLs.

results.title: An XML sitemap is available
results.summary: The core XML sitemap is enabled.

results.title: Site title and tagline are set
results.summary: The site has a title and no default tagline.

results.title: A site icon is set
results.summary: No site icon is set, so browsers show a generic icon.
results.recommendation: Upload a square image of at least 512 x 512 pixels as the site icon in Appearance > Customize.

results.title: The front page is configured correctly
results.summary: The front page shows the latest posts.

results.title: Default sample content has been removed
results.summary: Published sample content is still present: the "Hello world!" post, the "Sample Page" page.
results.recommendation: Delete or replace the default sample post and page before launch.

results.title: Comment and pingback defaults are intentional
results.summary: Discussion defaults: pingbacks and trackbacks are enabled for new content.
results.recommendation: Review Settings > Discussion: disable pingbacks unless needed and require moderation or a previously approved comment.

results.title: A privacy policy page is published
results.summary: The assigned privacy policy page is missing or not published.
results.recommendation: Write the policy (WordPress provides a template) and assign the published page in Settings > Privacy.

results.title: Authentication keys and salts are unique
results.summary: All eight authentication keys and salts are defined.

results.title: Open registration does not grant privileged roles
Administrator accounts are limited and not guessable
results.summary: Account hygiene: a user named "admin" exists.
results.recommendation: Rename or replace the "admin" login and give people only the role they need.

results.title: The dashboard file editor is disabled
results.summary: Administrators can edit theme and plugin code from the dashboard.
results.recommendation: Add define( 'DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true ); to wp-config.php so a compromised admin account cannot change code from the browser.

results.title: No leftover debug.log in wp-content
results.summary: A debug.log file exists in wp-content.
results.recommendation: Review and delete it, turn off WP_DEBUG_LOG on live sites, and make sure your server does not serve .log files.

results.title: Administration email address is real
results.summary: The administration email address uses a placeholder or reserved domain (example.com).
results.recommendation: Set a monitored address in Settings > General so WordPress notifications reach the site owner.

results.title: Outgoing email uses a configured transport
results.summary: No custom mail transport was detected, so WordPress will use PHP mail().
results.recommendation: Configure SMTP or a transactional email service and send a real test message, because form notifications and password resets often go missing otherwise.

results.title: The site timezone is set
results.summary: The timezone is still the default (UTC), so scheduled posts and dates may be off.
results.recommendation: Choose a city in the site timezone in Settings > General. Pick UTC explicitly if that is intended.
